anchor.comment: None of these, I want 3 more attempts at this, redesign it completely from the ground up, based on an old windows UI. It needs to feel really retro and oldschool. This theme has the potential to be one of the most distinct ones we have, so it needs to feel professionally done. Let me see why they call you world class
anchor.reply: Attempt 1 of 3, redesigned from the ground up: every candidate is now a moment of the 1995 desktop itself, drawn as it was (the teal desktop with its icons, the taskbar with Start and the clock, windows with a title-bar ramp, a menu bar and a status bar, dialog boxes with their icons and the dotted focus rectangle), in whole frames and never eased. Eight new candidates: the Copying dialog's sheet flying between two folders (recommended), Solitaire won and the cards cascading with their painted trail, Defrag reading and writing its blocks, the Start menu sliding up out of the taskbar, the message box that dings and flashes its title bar, Minesweeper's face reacting and the field flooding open, the Flying Through Space screensaver, a window dragged by its outline. None of round one's mechanics returns.
